description: List values for a specific label in Grafana Loki within the given time range.

end.description: End of the query window. Same formats as start. Default: now.

format.description: Output format: "raw" (one value per line, default), "json", or "text" (numbered list).

label.description: Label name to retrieve values for (for example: "app", "namespace", "job")

org.description: Organization/tenant ID for the query, sent as X-Scope-OrgID (env: LOKI_ORG_ID)

start.description: Start of the query window. Accepts "now", negative durations like "-1h", RFC3339, or "2006-01-02T15:04:05" / "2006-01-02 15:04:05" / "2006-01-02" (parsed as UTC). Default: 1h ago.

name: loki_label_values
